provenance: CPython error-message catalog (CORE-1679). Templates transcribed from CPython 3.10-3.13 runtime messages; 3.12+ rewordings and additions are separate rows keyed by version_added, and the 3.11 UnboundLocalError rewording carries version_removed on the pre-3.11 row. Spanish and Arabic enter at status='machine' pending native review (pack-correction policy: best-effort native-quality, review-gated). Stored templates are clean of bidi controls; isolation of interpolated values is applied at render time per the ratified code-vs-display policy.
